dog.description_text: Meet Fantasy — New Arrival! Fantasy just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about her time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/sites/GRP_NYC_Foster/Shared%20Documents/Forms/AllItems.aspx?id=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral%2FFantasy%20%2D%20About%20Me%2Epdf&parent=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral&p=true&share=cQr3ZE%5FV7Vx3T7ecQZfIsg13EgUDKPtDdfkQtrZE5%2Dvn3lFCYQ Her foster says "Fantasy was very curious on the subway and as soon as she arrived exploring every inch of the bathroom. She loves her cat caves and will knead the insides of the cave making biscuits. Her purr is rather quiet but she will rub into you when she wants attention. She is very sweet and is good with picking up and getting her nails cut. She loves a chin scratch and a butt scratch. Fanny will do almost anything for a Churu and will come running when she hears you open the tube. Her favorite activities are window watching on a perch and playing with a feather toy. She is also very good at using an enclosed litter box with a door. She is a very smart and cuddly cat who also enjoys her independence. She's very smart and you can see her figuring things out when you introduce a new toy or object for her." She is spayed, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure she is ready for her next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
